description: POC: chart reading — identify the peak day in a simple bar chart. Measures CHART RECOGNITION, NOT concision. Accepts natural-language answers within 600 chars as long as the correct day AND value are present. (max_chars raised from 180 → 600 in Phase 6 after live smoke caught honest chain-of-thought answers at 347 chars; matches the Phase-5 numeric_fact_match precedent set by vision-object-count-001.)

image_fixture.license: Luak-owned synthetic chart; rendered by scripts/generate-vision-fixtures.py
image_fixture.notes: Five bars labelled Mon..Fri (35/52/87/41/60). Peak (87, red) on Wednesday. Generator version 2026-05-25.v1.

questions.question: Which day has the highest bar in this chart, and what is its value?

metadata.author: crucibulum-core
metadata.diagnostic_purpose: POC for vision_chart_facts using numeric_fact_match. Pass if the response contains the peak value 87 AND mentions Wednesday (substring 'wed'). Accepts 'Wednesday at 87', 'Wed 87', 'The peak is Wednesday with 87.' etc.

known_scoring_limitations: If the model says 'Wednesday is highest' without quoting 87, it fails missing-count. Acceptable — the test measures both day AND value.
If the model says '87' but doesn't mention Wednesday, it fails missing-required-object. Acceptable — naming a value without the day isn't chart reading.
